title: Finding Keeper Rowan's Understory and the Gallows Glade (Thornwold's own grief) required guessing through many similarly-described wood rooms (Deer Break, Black Thorn Stand, Split Beech, Root Tangle, Listening Break) from prose-only directions ('west past the Waiting Bough', 'west five stands from Camp Gallows... then north twice') with no map or waypoint aid.
